title: Кібератаки групи UAC-0010 (Armageddon): шкідливі програми GammaLoad, GammaSteel (CERT-UA#5134)

entities.name: UAC-0010
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage group also known as Armageddon or Gamaredon.

entities.name: GammaLoad.PS1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell-based downloader malware used by UAC-0010 to drop secondary payloads.

entities.name: GammaSteel.PS1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell-based information stealing malware used by UAC-0010 to exfiltrate files.

entities.name: GammaSteel.NET
entities.gloss: A .NET-based credential-stealing malware used to extract authentication data from web browsers.

entities.name: HarvesterX
entities.gloss: A data-harvesting malware tool previously utilized by UAC-0010.

entities.name: Normal.dotm
entities.gloss: The default Microsoft Word template file frequently targeted for remote template injection.

entities.name: PowerShell
entities.gloss: A task automation and configuration management framework developed by Microsoft.

entities.name: wscript.exe
entities.gloss: A built-in Windows executable used to run VBScript and JScript scripts.

entities.name: mshta.exe
entities.gloss: A Windows utility that executes Microsoft HTML Applications (HTA).

relations.head: UAC-0010
relations.evidence: ініціюють ланцюг доставки GammaLoad.PS1 на комп'ютер жертви

relations.head: UAC-0010
relations.evidence: для чого застосовується GammaSteel.PS1 та GammaSteel.NET
